description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Cradle Clearcutter.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Cradle Clearcutter.
Repeat.

uses.name: Cradle Clearcutter
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
